title: AI Model Registry
description: Facts-only catalog of AI models: ids, providers, capabilities, current USD list prices, lifecycle status and id migrations. Contains no behavior (request settings, prompts, routing) — consumers own that.

schema_version.description: Incremented only for breaking changes to this schema.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last edit to registry.json.

providers.description: Provider key -> provider facts. Model.provider must reference a key here.

models.description: Ordered list. The order is part of the contract: consumers may render it verbatim.

migrations.description: Stale/retired model id -> successor id. Resolved by chaining until stable (cycle-safe); the final target must be a model id.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL, or null when the provider is reached through its native pydantic-ai prefix.

key_env.description: Environment variable holding the API key; null for providers needing no key (local).

pydantic_ai_prefix.description: pydantic-ai provider prefix ("anthropic:model"); null for a plain OpenAI-compatible endpoint reached via base_url.

id.description: Registry-wide unique id. This is the string consumers store and pass around.

api_model_id.description: The exact string sent to the provider API (may differ from id, e.g. a dated snapshot id).

aliases.description: Other names that resolve to this model without a migration (equivalent naming, not a successor relationship).

reasoning.description: How the model exposes reasoning depth. Consumers must degrade unknown future values to "none".

allows_temperature.description: False -> the API rejects temperature/top_p/top_k with a 400.

responses_api.description: True -> the model requires OpenAI's Responses API endpoint rather than Chat Completions.

server_web_tools.description: True -> provider-side web_search/web_fetch tools are available.

needs_pdf_rasterization.description: True -> the model cannot ingest PDFs natively; pages must be rasterized to images first.

max_reference_images.description: Image models: how many reference images the API accepts. Null when not applicable.

voices.description: Realtime/audio models: available voice ids. Null when not applicable.

status.description: Lifecycle. Deprecated/retired ids stay in the registry so old saved ids keep resolving; pair them with a migration.

pricing.description: CURRENT USD list price only. Null when no verified price is known — never guess. Git history is the price audit trail; this file never carries historical rates.

cached_input_per_1m.description: USD per 1M cached input tokens; null when the provider publishes no cached rate.

effective_from.description: Optional ISO date on which the current price took effect.

variants.description: Optional conditional rates (off-peak, batch, long-context...). Consumers MUST ignore variant conditions they do not recognise and fall back to the base rate.

condition.description: Open vocabulary, e.g. "off_peak", "long_context_gt_200k", "batch", "audio". Unknown values must be ignored, not rejected.

note.description: Free-text clarification of when the condition applies.

effective_from.description: Optional ISO date on which the current price took effect.

variants.description: Optional conditional per-image rates (quality tier, resolution...). Unknown conditions must be ignored.
